title: Backbone Matters: Benchmarking Encoder-Decoder Networks for Semantic Segmentation of Driving Scenes on BDD100K
abstract: arXiv:2611.26191v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic segmentation gives an autonomous vehicle a dense, pixel-level description of its surroundings and is a core part of scene understanding. Most segmentation networks consist of an encoder (the backbone) and a decoder, yet the backbone is often chosen without a systematic comparison. This work studies this choice on the BDD100K driving dataset. Four widely used decoders (U-Net, FPN, LinkNet and PSPNet) are combined with 13 backbones from six families (ResNet, VGG, DenseNet, Inception, MobileNet and EfficientNet), and all 52 models are trained with one common protocol. The best model, an FPN decoder with an EfficientNet-B4 backbone, reaches 62.6% mean intersection over union (mIoU), 89.8% accuracy and a loss of 0.092. Only two of the 52 models, both FPN with EfficientNet, exceed the 56.9% mIoU reported with the BDD100K benchmark. The effect of the backbone depends strongly on the decoder: the same EfficientNet-B4 gives 42.6% mIoU

translated_title: 主干网络至关重要：在BDD100K上对驾驶场景语义分割的编码器-解码器网络进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 语义分割为自动驾驶车辆提供对其周围环境的密集像素级描述，是场景理解的核心组成部分。大多数分割网络由编码器（即主干网络）和解码器组成，然而主干网络的选择往往缺乏系统性的比较。本工作在BDD100K驾驶数据集上研究了这一选择问题。研究将四种广泛使用的解码器（U-Net、FPN、LinkNet和PSPNet）与来自六个家族（ResNet、VGG、DenseNet、Inception、MobileNet和EfficientNet）的13种主干网络进行组合，全部52个模型均在统一的训练协议下进行训练。表现最佳的模型——采用EfficientNet-B4主干网络的FPN解码器——达到了62.6%的平均交并比（mIoU）、89.8%的准确率和0.092的损失。在52个模型中，仅有两个模型（均为采用EfficientNet的FPN）超过了BDD100K基准报告的56.9% mIoU。主干网络的效果在很大程度上取决于解码器：相同的EfficientNet-B4在不同解码器下给出了42.6%的mIoU（摘要原文在此处似乎被截断）。
tldr: 该论文在BDD100K数据集上对52种编码器-解码器组合进行了系统性基准测试，发现EfficientNet-B4主干网络搭配FPN解码器在驾驶场景语义分割中表现最佳（62.6% mIoU），并且主干网络的效果强烈依赖于所搭配的解码器。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically benchmarks 52 encoder-decoder combinations on BDD100K, finding that EfficientNet-B4 paired with an FPN decoder achieves the best driving scene semantic segmentation performance (62.6% mIoU), and that the backbone's effectiveness strongly depends on the paired decoder.
